notes: Manitoba's general consumer statute: unfair business practices, cost-of-credit disclosure, high-cost credit, direct sales, gift cards, motor-vehicle dealers and more. Residential tenancy is a separate statute, The Residential Tenancies Act, C.C.S.M. c. R119 (S.M. 1990-91, c. 11), whose legislative-history page also reads 'updated to: September 18, 2026'.
